linkedin_text:
Not every lead deserves an hour of your day.

When you're running a growing business, chasing the wrong prospects doesn't just waste time—it drains the energy you need for your best clients. 

Before you jump on another discovery call, look for these three simple green flags:
1. A clear problem: They can name the exact headache they need solved today, not just "looking around."
2. Real urgency: They have an active timeline to fix it, rather than "maybe next quarter."
3. Genuine engagement: They actually open your emails, answer your questions, and show up ready to talk.

Simple marketing automation can track these cues in the background, so your calendar only fills with people who are truly ready to work with you.

What’s your favorite telltale sign that a lead is going to be a dream client? Let’s swap notes in the comments!
